engines.purpose: Shared design values, font loading and canonical SVG geometry
engines.mechanism: 82 typed tokens, CSS custom properties, local variable fonts and editable SVG paths; CSS is a delivered companion, not generated at browser runtime
engines.limits: Changes to JSON do not automatically rewrite CSS, motion geometry or exports

engines.purpose: 22 screen types and bounded P1–P5 prototype flows
engines.mechanism: Query screen/lang -> bodyFor() -> HTML; delegated data-go/data-action/data-form events; History API routing; in-memory demonstration state
engines.limits: No recommendation model, server, real account, live catalog or backend persistence. Recommendations are fixed authored examples; changing description/context does not calculate a new outfit

engines.mechanism: Local data script and gallery renderer; source catalog carries anatomy/properties/states/keyboard/localization references; optional synchronization tool regenerates the local JavaScript data companion from canonical JSON
engines.limits: Gallery and prototype share foundations but are separate source renderers; a gallery edit does not automatically update app.js

engines.purpose: 4.8-second brand scene, fixed full identity fallback and controls
engines.mechanism: Measure Do/Laby after fonts load, one requestAnimationFrame clock, clamped smoothstep positions, reveal and retrieval masks; optional ?t=seconds deterministic preview
engines.limits: No autoplay; browser visibility/offscreen pauses; no automatic resume. Native reduced-motion preference runtime remains untested; source and static fallback inspected

engines.purpose: 24 template concepts, AR/EN blank/filled versions and complete carousel examples
engines.mechanism: Query/default or SOCIAL_CONFIG -> template record -> editable artboard; local FileReader image replacement; clone current HTML, remove scripts/toolbar and download snapshot
engines.limits: Saved HTML retains editable text, embedded selected image and relative dependencies; it has no template-switching engine. Save does not generate PNG/JPG or publish

engines.mechanism: Inline 4-second requestAnimationFrame opacity timeline, intro/outro selector, play/replay/skip and deterministic ?t preview; fixed 1080x1920 artboard
engines.limits: Editable HTML/CSS/JS/SVG source; no encoded video/audio file produced. Native reduced-motion and full runtime-control matrix not separately exercised

engines.purpose: Regenerate indexed UI/social outputs, brand book PDF and core vector derivatives into a separate folder
engines.mechanism: Isolated Playwright Chromium document renderer with explicit CSS viewport and local fonts; Sharp vector/PNG/JPG processing; JSON execution report
engines.limits: Requires optional local tool dependencies. The existing delivered assets open without Node. Does not create native Figma/Canva/3D/video or perform a full accessibility audit

engines.purpose: Verify supplied file hashes and optional ZIP members
engines.mechanism: Python standard-library SHA256 and ZIP CRC/member comparison
engines.limits: A hash proves byte identity, not product quality, legal clearance or demand
engines.hash_note: Delivery manifest is intentionally not hashed here to avoid a circular manifest/engine-map dependency; final archive hash is in the adjacent receipt.

engines.purpose: Seven entity definitions for future production implementation
engines.mechanism: Human-readable fields and synthetic examples, not an installed database or executable schema validator
engines.limits: No live API endpoints, migrations, authentication policies or production storage were created
